ruleDefinitions.name: ProcessHacker Privilege Elevation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a ProcessHacker tool that elevated privileges to a very high level Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ServiceName, AccountName

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045 AND ServiceName = RGX("^ProcessHacker") AND AccountName = "LocalSystem")
